Name: Jehu, Son of Nimshi
Summary: Jehu, son of Nimshi, was anointed by the LORD to cut off the house of Ahab; executing that judgment, he slew the princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah's brethren, and then slew Ahaziah himself.
KeyStory: When Jehu executed judgment upon the house of Ahab, he found Judah's princes ministering to Ahaziah and slew them, then sought and slew Ahaziah.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Ahaziah, King of Judah
LifeLesson: God's judgment on one house can sweep up its allies as well.
